selection_rule: Frozen TinyLLaVA features validated through the full cache gate; the LayerNorm-Dropout-Linear head is trained independently for each released benchmark lambda, with cost_scale=100 and all-wrong rows excluded from soft cross-entropy. Source-dev soft loss selects the epoch; group-isolated three-fold source-fit OOF Rank selects lambda. Missing-image features use the train-global strongest expert, index 12, verified independently on every source fold. Test-selected lambda is a labelled supplement diagnostic only.
